## Level-up flow

**When offered:** Worker computes `shouldLevelUp(character)` (`worker/src/services/character.ts:159`) = `xp >= XP_THRESHOLDS[level]` (`worker/src/types/index.ts:175`: 0,300,900,2700,6500,14000,23000,34000,48000,64000) and `level < 10`. Returned as `canLevelUp` from `POST /api/action` (`routes/action.ts:99`) and `POST /api/combat/resolve` (`routes/combat.ts:109`). Frontend shows a banner (`character-sheet.component.html:66`) and ability picker (`game-console.component.html:19-28`), trusting the server flag (set in `game-console.component.ts:128,155`).

**Endpoint call:** Picking an ability calls `levelUp(key)` (`game-console.component.ts:183`) → `GameApiService.levelUp(sessionId, characterId, abilityChoice)` (`game-api.service.ts:74`) → **`POST /api/levelup`** (`worker/src/routes/levelup.ts:10`). `abilityChoice` must be one of str/dex/con/int/wis/cha (validated `:23-25`); returns 400 if `!shouldLevelUp` (`:31`).

**Character changes** — `services/character.ts:133` `levelUp`:
- `level` +1
- HP gain = `roll(class hit die) + CON mod` (`:141`), added to both `max_hp` and current HP (hit dice: Fighter/Ranger d10, Rogue/Cleric/Bard d8, Wizard d6 via `CLASS_HIT_DICE`)
- **+2** to the chosen ability score
- AC unchanged; ability scores are **not** capped at 20

**Side effects:** flavor text via `generateLevelUpNarrative` (usually fallback text — known bug B-03), a `[Level Up] …` system log row, and a DM history turn (`routes/levelup.ts:39-50`). Frontend then calls `setCharacter`, `setCanLevelUp(false)`, shows a system message, and updates the campaign slot level (`game-console.component.ts:187-194`).

Note: one level per call — a character with enough XP for two levels must call `/api/levelup` twice.
